_notes: Per-creature drops for non-gear LootItems (quest/material/trash) - checked in combat/combat_engine.py's _resolve_victory alongside the existing gear roll. Each entry is a list of possible drops; each drop rolls independently against its own chance, so a creature can drop more than one thing from one kill.

Sagewood Sprite.name: Sagewood Petal
Sagewood Sprite.description: A fragrant petal, still cool to the touch. Old Marta wants these fresh.

Voodoo Troll.name: Hexed Darkspear Totem
Voodoo Troll.description: A Darkspear fetish, twisted by Zalazane's hex but not beyond recognizing. Still warm with old magic.

Hex Troll.name: Hexed Darkspear Totem
Hex Troll.description: A Darkspear fetish, twisted by Zalazane's hex but not beyond recognizing. Still warm with old magic.

Sunbaked Vulture.name: Sunbaked Vulture Feather
Sunbaked Vulture.description: A long, sun-bleached feather, remarkably free of scorch marks.

Kolkar Raider.name: Salvaged Caravan Crate
Kolkar Raider.description: A battered supply crate, contents mostly intact despite everything.

Kolkar Raider.name: Trampled Grain Sack
Kolkar Raider.description: A grain sack torn from a raided supply wagon, dirty but the grain inside is still good.

Kolkar Raider.name: Kolkar War-Pennant
Kolkar Raider.description: A strip of dyed hide on a bone pole. Every pennant is a boast, and each of these is a boast that did not pan out.

Kolkar Marauder.name: Sunworn Horn
Kolkar Marauder.description: A centaur's horn, bleached pale by years under the Barrens sun. Good carving material.

Southsea Brigand.name: Waterlogged Strongbox
Southsea Brigand.description: A small strongbox, swollen shut with seawater. Whatever's inside survived the crossing.

Southsea Brigand.name: Salvaged Cargo Crate
Southsea Brigand.description: A small crate with a Ratchet customs stamp half burned out. It rattles. It might be rum.

Witchwing Harpy.name: Witchwing Feather
Witchwing Harpy.description: A long, dark feather still crackling faintly with residual magic.

Bristleback Raider.name: Quilboar Battle Hide
Bristleback Raider.description: Tough, scarred hide from a quilboar warrior - good material regardless of which tribe it came from.

Bristleback Raider.name: Ceremonial Bristleback Tusk
Bristleback Raider.description: A carved tusk, worn as a mark of status among the Bristleback. Worth real money to the right collector.

Razormane Veteran.name: Quilboar Battle Hide
Razormane Veteran.description: Tough, scarred hide from a quilboar warrior - good material regardless of which tribe it came from.

Razormane Veteran.name: Razormane Quill Bundle
Razormane Veteran.description: Thick quills bound in sinew, still tacky with dried poison. Handle by the string.

Dreadmist Cultist.name: Cultist Hoarded Coin
Dreadmist Cultist.description: A pouch of coin, looted from caravans over the years and never spent.

Dreadmist Warlock.name: Cultist Hoarded Coin
Dreadmist Warlock.description: A pouch of coin, looted from caravans over the years and never spent.

Silithid Guardian.name: Hardened Silithid Chitin
Silithid Guardian.description: Tough plated chitin, useful for armor crafting.

Silithid Stinger.name: Silithid Stinger Barb
Silithid Stinger.description: A venomous barb, still faintly toxic.

Sunscale Lashtail.name: Sunscale Raptor Hide
Sunscale Lashtail.description: Tough scaled hide, prized by leatherworkers.

Sunscale Lashtail.name: Sunscale Raptor Egg
Sunscale Lashtail.description: A warm, speckled egg, carefully carried.

Sunscale Screecher.name: Sunscale Raptor Hide
Sunscale Screecher.description: Tough scaled hide, prized by leatherworkers.

Den Webspinner.name: Den Silk Spool
Den Webspinner.description: A tight spool of webspinner silk, strong enough to turn a scorpid sting. Rhaka wants these.

Cave Skitterer.name: Den Silk Spool
Cave Skitterer.description: A tight spool of webspinner silk, strong enough to turn a scorpid sting. Rhaka wants these.

Burning Blade Acolyte.name: Fel-Tainted Shard
Burning Blade Acolyte.description: A pocket-sized crystal shard, warm and wrong. Fizzcrank wants to measure it. Use tongs.

Coven Ritual Guard.name: Fel-Tainted Shard
Coven Ritual Guard.description: A pocket-sized crystal shard, warm and wrong. Fizzcrank wants to measure it. Use tongs.

Burning Blade Initiate.name: Fel-Tainted Shard
Burning Blade Initiate.description: A pocket-sized crystal shard, warm and wrong. Fizzcrank wants to measure it. Use tongs.

Durotar Prowler.name: Prowler Pelt
Durotar Prowler.description: A thick, sand-coloured pelt, still warm. Grosk says it's the best blanket money can't buy.

Mesa Stonebiter.name: Glittering Mesa Ore
Mesa Stonebiter.description: A chunk of glittering ore, still faintly gnawed. Fitz would love to know how.

Razormane Quilboar.name: Razormane Toll Pouch
Razormane Quilboar.description: A small leather pouch, heavy with other people's coin. Bok recognises the stitching.

Ragefire Digger.name: Ragefire Ore Sample
Ragefire Digger.description: Black rock shot through with orange veins. Still faintly warm, still faintly angry.

Molten Elemental.name: Ragefire Ore Sample
Molten Elemental.description: Black rock shot through with orange veins. Still faintly warm, still faintly angry.

Searing Blade Pyromancer.name: Searing Ritual Ash
Searing Blade Pyromancer.description: Grey ash that smells of sulphur and iron. Nobody burns this by accident.

Searing Blade Cultist.name: Searing Ritual Ash
Searing Blade Cultist.description: Grey ash that smells of sulphur and iron. Nobody burns this by accident.

Isle Coconut Crab.name: Sturdy Reef Coral
Isle Coconut Crab.description: Deep-red coral, tougher than the decorative kind. The crabs drag it up the beach to line their burrows.

Bilge Eel.name: Eel-Hide Cord
Bilge Eel.description: A supple length of cured eel-skin. It will hold a net together through a storm. It will not hold a grudge.

Drowned Crewman.name: Waterlogged Chart
Drowned Crewman.description: A sea chart gone to pulp at the edges. The middle is still legible: a ring of islands and a cross in red.

Waterlogged Gunner.name: Waterlogged Chart
Waterlogged Gunner.description: A sea chart gone to pulp at the edges. The middle is still legible: a ring of islands and a cross in red.

Naga Coastguard.name: Tide-Etched Naga Scale
Naga Coastguard.description: A pearly scale scored with spiral runes. The marks move if you stare at them.

Naga Tidecaller.name: Tide-Etched Naga Scale
Naga Tidecaller.description: A pearly scale scored with spiral runes. The marks move if you stare at them.

Naga Tidecaller.name: Hummingtide Pearl
Naga Tidecaller.description: A grey-green pearl that hums when you stop looking at it. The air around it smells like low tide.

Grotto Murloc.name: Tide-Touched Pearl
Grotto Murloc.description: A grey pearl that is damp no matter how long it sits in the sun.

Tidal Elemental.name: Tide-Touched Pearl
Tidal Elemental.description: A grey pearl that is damp no matter how long it sits in the sun.

Zalazane Fetish-Carver.name: Hex-Carved Bone Shard
Zalazane Fetish-Carver.description: A sliver of bone with a Darkspear name cut into it, then crossed out. Zathra says that is the worst part.

Zalazane Fetish-Carver.name: Hexed Darkspear Totem
Zalazane Fetish-Carver.description: A Darkspear fetish, twisted by Zalazane's hex but not beyond recognizing. Still warm with old magic.

Plains Thunderhawk.name: Thunderhawk Pinion
Plains Thunderhawk.description: A flight feather as long as a forearm, faintly charged. Your hair stands up when you hold it.

Kolkar Windseer.name: Kolkar Windseer Totem
Kolkar Windseer.description: A bundle of kodo-hair and bone that spins on its own when the wind is wrong. The wind is usually wrong.

Kolkar Stormer.name: Kolkar Windseer Totem
Kolkar Stormer.description: A bundle of kodo-hair and bone that spins on its own when the wind is wrong. The wind is usually wrong.

Farm Poacher.name: Grol'dom's Seed Sack
Farm Poacher.description: Burlap, stamped with a hoe. Somebody's whole next season, slung over a thief's shoulder.

Oasis Tangle-Vine.name: Tangle-Vine Heart
Oasis Tangle-Vine.description: A knot of green vine that beats, slowly, like it hasn't been told it is dead.

Drowned Pilgrim.name: Pilgrim's Prayer Beads
Drowned Pilgrim.description: Wooden beads worn smooth by one thumb, over a very long walk to a very dry pool.

Bandit Bombardier.name: Bandit Powder Keg
Bandit Bombardier.description: A small keg, a long fuse and a label that says DO NOT in three languages.

Razormane Quillthrower.name: Razormane Quill Bundle
Razormane Quillthrower.description: Thick quills bound in sinew, still tacky with dried poison. Handle by the string.

Bristleback Battleboar.name: Battleboar Tusk
Bristleback Battleboar.description: A yellowed tusk with a notch cut in it for every fight the boar won. There are a lot of notches.

Riverbank Snapper.name: Snapper Shell Plate
Riverbank Snapper.description: A palm-wide plate of river-turtle shell, thick as a sword guard and a good deal less polite.

Dreadmist Imp.name: Smouldering Imp-Heart
Dreadmist Imp.description: A cinder the size of a plum. It is still warm, and it still, faintly, giggles.

Gravel Skitterer.name: Glittering Rift Geode
Gravel Skitterer.description: A fist-sized geode that was cracked open by something with a very tidy mind. Inside, the crystals hum.

Bone-Dust Wraith.name: Giant's Knucklebone
Bone-Dust Wraith.description: A knuckle the size of your head, still faintly warm in the sun. Whatever it was attached to was not impressed by you.

Bael'dun Sergeant.name: Bael'dun Dispatch
Bael'dun Sergeant.description: A folded, wax-sealed order in tidy dwarven runes. The wax is red. So, increasingly, is the paper.

Dwarf Explosives Expert.name: Dwarven Powder Charge
Dwarf Explosives Expert.description: Brass-bound and stamped with a label that says CAREFUL in four languages. The fifth label has been scratched out.

Dig-Site Golem.name: Golem Core Shard
Dig-Site Golem.description: A chip of enchanted stone that remembers being told what to do, and is still waiting for the next order.

Modan Overseer.name: Torn Dig-Ledger Page
Modan Overseer.description: A page of numbers: ore in, ore out, workers lost. The last column has been written in a much firmer hand.

Razormane Skinner.name: Skinner's Trophy Cord
Razormane Skinner.description: A braided cord hung with ears, claws and one small bell. The bell is not a trophy. The bell is a warning.

Spire Windcaller.name: Windspire Crystal
Spire Windcaller.description: A shard of glassy sandstone that sings when held up to the wind. It does not stop when you put it down.

Brood Tunnel-Guard.name: Tunnel-Guard Chitin Plate
Brood Tunnel-Guard.description: A curved plate of chitin, hard as iron and about as friendly. It rings when you tap it. Something below answers.

Hive Weaver.name: Hive-Amber Shard
Hive Weaver.description: A shard of hard golden resin with something very small, and very annoyed, preserved inside.

Resin Spitter.name: Hive-Amber Shard
Resin Spitter.description: A shard of hard golden resin with something very small, and very annoyed, preserved inside.

Razorfen Geomancer.name: Kraul Seed-Pod
Razorfen Geomancer.description: A barbed seed-pod the size of a fist. It ticks when you hold it. Oggra wants them gone from the hill.

Razorfen Ward-Keeper.name: Ward Seal-Stone
Razorfen Ward-Keeper.description: A palm-sized stone etched with a binding ward, still warm from the force that held the pit shut.

Fang Initiate.name: Fang Totem Shard
Fang Initiate.description: A shard of green-glazed clay, scratched with a coiled serpent. Initiates break one at the end of each rite.

Nightmare Wisp.name: Nightmare Dewdrop
Nightmare Wisp.description: A bead of dew that does not evaporate. It sees things; you would rather it did not tell you.

Mutanus the Devourer.name: Naralex's Dream-Pearl
Mutanus the Devourer.description: A pearl of green light, warm as a heartbeat. Naralex dreamed it, once, before the nightmare did the dreaming.

Slug.name: Slug Venom Gland
Slug.description: A wet, mustard-coloured gland. It is warmer than it has any right to be, and it twitches.

Peat Shambler.name: Peat Heart
Peat Shambler.description: A fist of dense black peat that holds its shape like muscle. It is faintly, unnervingly pulsing.

Sentinel Picket.name: Sentinel Signal Horn
Sentinel Picket.description: A curved silver horn, still warm from a night-elf mouth. One long call and the pickets know where the Horde is.

Pumpjack Guard.name: Pumpjack Pressure Gauge
Pumpjack Guard.description: A brass gauge, needle pinned at the red. The Venture Co. does not stamp its name on these. It stamps a price.

Sludge Elemental.name: Crude Sludge Sample
Sludge Elemental.description: A stoppered flask of the sludge that is not strictly oil, anymore, and not strictly dead.

Kolkar Dervish.name: Dervish Curved Blade
Kolkar Dervish.description: A short, hooked blade, hot to the touch. Dervishes spin until they glow. The blades take longer to cool.

Road Bandit.name: Highwayman's Ledger
Road Bandit.description: A greasy tally of caravans, with prices, in a very neat hand. The neatness is the disturbing part.

Witchwing Windcaller.name: Witchwing Hex-Totem
Witchwing Windcaller.description: Feathers, knucklebone and a thread of human hair. It hums in a key that makes your fillings ache.

Cavern Rock Elemental.name: Vein Core Sample
Cavern Rock Elemental.description: A palm-sized core of crystal-veined rock, still ringing from the drill that did not finish it.

Ore Sprite.name: Ore Sprite Shard
Ore Sprite.description: A shard of living crystal that hums quietly and goes cold when you look at it for too long.

Roost Bonepicker.name: Roost Down
Roost Bonepicker.description: A handful of grey-brown down. Harpies line their nests with it, and the nests are not clean.

Twilight Rootbinder.name: Blighted Root Sample
Twilight Rootbinder.description: A fist-sized knot of root, black at the core and still faintly warm. The Moonwell's sap runs through it, and it is wrong.

Gloomcap Sporeling.name: Gloomcap Spore Sac
Gloomcap Sporeling.description: A swollen sac that smells of old cellars. Handle it gently, and then don't.

Timberling.name: Timberling Heartwood
Timberling.description: A hand-length of dense, red-gold heartwood, still faintly warm. The wards at Maestra's Post are carved from exactly this.

Elder Timberling.name: Timberling Heartwood
Elder Timberling.description: A hand-length of dense, red-gold heartwood, still faintly warm. The wards at Maestra's Post are carved from exactly this.

Furbolg Shaman.name: Corrupted Furbolg Totem
Furbolg Shaman.description: A bone-and-sinew totem with something black seeping through the carving. It hums when you stop paying attention to it.

Wisp.name: Wisp-Light Essence
Wisp.description: A pale mote of light in a pinch of dew. It does not burn, and it will not stay in a closed fist.

Nightsaber Stalker.name: Windrunner Family Locket
Nightsaber Stalker.description: A small silver locket, dented by teeth, with a painted portrait of a family inside. Thessaly will know it.

Fel Imp.name: Scavenged Outpost Scrap
Fel Imp.description: A bent hinge, a strap buckle, a scrap of Horde canvas. Carried off and hoarded by something that can't possibly have a use for any of it.

Ragged Scavenger.name: Stolen Village Scrap
Ragged Scavenger.description: Supplies pulled out of Deathknell's stores: a tin of salt, a bundle of rope. They were counted carefully the day before they went missing.

Ragged Scavenger.name: Stolen Cargo Crate
Ragged Scavenger.description: A small crate, battered and half-opened.

Agamand Servant.name: Shackle Key
Agamand Servant.description: A heavy iron key, cold as a grave. It fits the locks on the farmers' shackles.

Frostbitten Huntsman.name: Cracked Hunting Horn
Frostbitten Huntsman.description: A horn of pale bone, split down one side. It still tries to sound when the wind finds it.

Felguard Legionnaire.name: Legion Brand Plate
Felguard Legionnaire.description: A palm-sized plate of fel-iron stamped with the Legion's mark. The edges are still warm.

Burning Blade Cultist.name: Blood-Written Orders
Burning Blade Cultist.description: A scrap of hide with a few lines of crabbed script, written in something that is not ink. The lines don't agree with each other.

Forest Spider.name: Heavy Spider Silk
Forest Spider.description: A skein of silk as thick as a bowstring, tacky and strong. It would hold a grown bear.

Murloc Hydra.name: Hydra Fang
Murloc Hydra.description: A curved fang as long as your hand, still wet. Whatever it bit had it twice.

Restless Grave-Dweller.name: Weathered Grave Marker
Restless Grave-Dweller.description: A splintered marker with half a name. Somebody was loved, once.

Grave Rat.name: Weathered Grave Marker
Grave Rat.description: A splintered marker with half a name. Somebody was loved, once.

Wretched Zombie.name: Tattered Burial Shroud
Wretched Zombie.description: Good linen, ruined. Sexton Marrow will know whose.

Rattlecage Skeleton.name: Tattered Burial Shroud
Rattlecage Skeleton.description: Good linen, ruined. Sexton Marrow will know whose.

Claim Spider.name: Spun Gold Thread
Claim Spider.description: Spider-silk laced with real gold dust. Glints in the dark.

Drowned Wretch.name: Tarnished Keepsake
Drowned Wretch.description: A ring, a locket, a ribbon. Somebody left it at the pond.

Drowned Wretch.name: Iceshard Fragment
Drowned Wretch.description: A shard of black ice that does not melt.

Weeping Shade.name: Tarnished Keepsake
Weeping Shade.description: A ring, a locket, a ribbon. Somebody left it at the pond.

Weeping Shade.name: Iceshard Fragment
Weeping Shade.description: A shard of black ice that does not melt.

Burned Farmhand.name: Unburnt Seed Packet
Burned Farmhand.description: Paper, singed at the edges. The seeds inside are still good.

Blighted Scarecrow.name: Unburnt Seed Packet
Blighted Scarecrow.description: Paper, singed at the edges. The seeds inside are still good.

Scarlet Picket.name: Scarlet Dispatch
Scarlet Picket.description: Orders for tomorrow's burning, in a neat clerical hand.

Scarlet Torchbearer.name: Scarlet Dispatch
Scarlet Torchbearer.description: Orders for tomorrow's burning, in a neat clerical hand.

Vile Fin Minor Oracle.name: Oracle's Pearl
Vile Fin Minor Oracle.description: A salt-white pearl, cold and faintly humming.

Vile Fin Puddlejumper.name: Oracle's Pearl
Vile Fin Puddlejumper.description: A salt-white pearl, cold and faintly humming.

Scarlet Convert.name: Crusade Orders
Scarlet Convert.description: Folded orders, signed in a neat red hand.

Scarlet Initiate.name: Crusade Orders
Scarlet Initiate.description: Folded orders, signed in a neat red hand.

Solliden Farmhand.name: Moldering Locket
Solliden Farmhand.description: A tarnished locket. The inscription on the back is still legible.

Agamand Crypt Wight.name: Grave Relic
Agamand Crypt Wight.description: A small carved token from the Agamand vault.

Rot Hide Graverobber.name: Grave Relic
Rot Hide Graverobber.description: A small carved token from the Agamand vault.

Bethor Iceshard.name: Iceshard Fragment
Bethor Iceshard.description: A shard of black ice that does not melt.

Faol's Restless.name: Faol's Seal Fragment
Faol's Restless.description: A carved stone fragment, worn smooth by pilgrims.

Venomweb Skitterer.name: Venom Sac
Venomweb Skitterer.description: A swollen gland that oozes at a touch.

Vicious Night Web Spider.name: Venom Sac
Vicious Night Web Spider.description: A swollen gland that oozes at a touch.

Cult Acolyte.name: Cult Ledger Page
Cult Acolyte.description: A page of names, tallies and debts.

Cult Fanatic.name: Cult Ledger Page
Cult Fanatic.description: A page of names, tallies and debts.

Lordaeron Remnant.name: Lordaeron Signet
Lordaeron Remnant.description: A tarnished ring bearing the old court's crest.

Rotting Dead.name: Moldering Locket
Rotting Dead.description: A tarnished locket. The inscription on the back is still legible.

Scarlet Bowman.name: Bloodied Scarlet Orders
Scarlet Bowman.description: Crusade orders, torn and stained. Troop positions and patrol times.

Scarlet Zealot.name: Bloodied Scarlet Orders
Scarlet Zealot.description: Crusade orders, torn and stained. Troop positions and patrol times.

Scourge Necromancer.name: Scourge Rune Shard
Scourge Necromancer.description: A shard of black rune-stone, etched and cold to the touch.

Scourge Warrior.name: Scourge Rune Shard
Scourge Warrior.description: A shard of black rune-stone, etched and cold to the touch.

Plaguemaster Orvyn.name: Plaguemaster's Formula
Plaguemaster Orvyn.description: Stained notes, dosages and a diagram of the cult's delivery vats.

Plague Spore.name: Sump Sludge Vial
Plague Spore.description: A stoppered vial of the green-grey sludge the Cistern breeds. The glass is warm.

Rot Worm.name: Sump Sludge Vial
Rot Worm.description: A stoppered vial of the green-grey sludge the Cistern breeds. The glass is warm.

Plague Surgeon.name: Surgeon's Case Notes
Plague Surgeon.description: Bloodstained pages in a steady hand. The last entries are less steady.

Blighted Courtier.name: Courtier's Blighted Ledger
Blighted Courtier.description: A court ledger, every name struck through and every sum still correct.

Failed Experiment.name: Vat-Born Tissue
Failed Experiment.description: A fist of grey tissue that is still working out what it was meant to be.

The Infected Noble.name: Faulkner Signet
The Infected Noble.description: A heavy gold ring set with the crest of a house that no longer exists. The crest is wet.

Plague Keeper Voss.name: Voss's Plague Codex
Plague Keeper Voss.description: A ledger bound in something that used to be skin. Every page is a recipe.

Plagued Courier.name: Unsealed Plague Vial
Plagued Courier.description: A sealed vial taken off a courier, stamped with the Apothecary Society's wax. A hairline crack.

Skeletal Groundskeeper.name: Grave-Goods Shard
Skeletal Groundskeeper.description: A ring-shard of tarnished silver, still warm from burial.

Skeletal Groundskeeper.name: Cracked Silver Locket
Skeletal Groundskeeper.description: A silver locket with a single pressed flower inside.

Skeletal Groundskeeper.name: Groundskeeper's Ledger Scrap
Skeletal Groundskeeper.description: A torn fragment of a ledger in the Cult's cipher, folded small.

Silverpine Spider.name: Silverpine Venom Gland
Silverpine Spider.description: A greenish gland, still faintly pulsing.

Silverpine Spider.name: Silverpine Spider Fat
Silverpine Spider.description: A pale, waxy gland. Burns clean.

Risen Farmhand.name: Farthing Seed Sack
Risen Farmhand.description: A small, singed sack of wheat seed.

Risen Farmhand.name: Wilted Offering
Risen Farmhand.description: A spray of flowers that never reached its grave.

Risen Farmhand.name: Farmhand's Silver Locket
Risen Farmhand.description: A small silver locket on a broken chain. The clasp is stuck.

Grave Moss Creeper.name: Grave-Moss Clipping
Grave Moss Creeper.description: Grey-green moss, thick with bone dust.

Dead Field Harrower.name: Harrower's Straw Charm
Dead Field Harrower.description: A sewn straw charm, stitched in a wife's careful hand.

Orchard Shambler.name: Rotapple Core
Orchard Shambler.description: A black, heavy seed-core, faintly warm.

Rot Hide Slitherer.name: Slitherer Fang
Rot Hide Slitherer.description: A curved, wet fang. Handle with tongs.

Venomfang Skitterer.name: Skitterer Egg Sac
Venomfang Skitterer.description: A silk-wrapped egg sac, warm to the touch.

Blighted Crow.name: Tarnished Gold Ring
Blighted Crow.description: A gold band, pecked loose from a nest. Inscribed on the inside.

Field Deserter.name: March Deserter's Tag
Field Deserter.description: An iron tag stamped with a March number.

Field Deserter.name: Deserter's Sealed Letter
Field Deserter.description: A letter addressed to someone in the Undercity. The seal is unbroken.

Battlefield Wight.name: Battlefield Long-Bone
Battlefield Wight.description: A long bone, picked clean. Someone's arm, once.

Diseased Wolf.name: Diseased Wolf Pelt
Diseased Wolf.description: A mangy pelt. It will clean up, mostly.

Barn Ghoul.name: Bucklebree Quilt Scrap
Barn Ghoul.description: A square of hand-stitched quilt, stained with barn straw.

Bloated Corpse.name: Sealed Marsh-Gas Bladder
Bloated Corpse.description: A swollen, foul bladder. It wobbles.

Mine Shambler.name: Company Mining Lamp
Mine Shambler.description: A battered brass lamp, stamped with the Deep Elem mark.

Pyrewood Cultist.name: Pyrewood Cult Sigil
Pyrewood Cultist.description: A dull iron disc etched with a cipher you'd rather not read.

Talon Wraith.name: Wraith-Held Token
Talon Wraith.description: A small keepsake, cold as a gravestone.

Peril Packmaster.name: Packmaster's Tooth-Necklace
Peril Packmaster.description: A string of worgen teeth, each one a rival.

Wall Wraith.name: Wall Guard's Seal
Wall Wraith.description: A lion-stamped iron seal, rubbed smooth.

Ambermill Warden.name: Warden's Amber Resin
Ambermill Warden.description: A warm lump of hardened resin.

Drowned Deckhand.name: Waterlogged Cargo Crate
Drowned Deckhand.description: A small crate, sealed with Dalaran wax.

Drowned Deckhand.name: Decrepit Ferry Ticket
Drowned Deckhand.description: A water-stained ticket stub for a crossing to Fenris Isle.

Risen Husk.name: Dry Marrow-Bone
Risen Husk.description: A pale, dry shin-bone, ideal for carving.

Windfall Wasp.name: Windfall Wasp Sting
Windfall Wasp.description: A glistening black barb, still wet.

Giant Spider.name: Silverpine Spider Fat
Giant Spider.description: A pale, waxy gland. Burns clean.

Venom Stalker.name: Stalker Venom Sac
Venom Stalker.description: A swollen venom sac, thick as syrup.

Tome Wraith.name: Torn Archive Page
Tome Wraith.description: A hovering page, ink still wet.

Forsaken Alchemist.name: Sealed Reagent Vial
Forsaken Alchemist.description: A wax-sealed vial. It's warm to the touch.

Forsaken Alchemist.name: Flask-Stained Ledger
Forsaken Alchemist.description: A ledger gone green at the edges.

Haunted Servitor.name: Servant's Key Ring
Haunted Servitor.description: A heavy iron ring of keep keys, still faintly warm.

Isle Banshee.name: Banshee's Lock of Hair
Isle Banshee.description: A pale lock, cold as lake water.

Drowned Harpooner.name: Bent Harpoon Head
Drowned Harpooner.description: An iron head, bent the same way every time.

Feral Packmaster.name: Ashbury Hound Collar
Feral Packmaster.description: A studded collar stamped with the Ashbury crest.

Cursed Noble.name: Noble House Signet
Cursed Noble.description: A cracked signet ring, still bearing a house's crest.

Moonhowl Worgen.name: Moonhowl Fang
Moonhowl Worgen.description: A curved fang, tinted pale as moonlight.

Brood Warden.name: Silk-Wrapped Journal Page
Brood Warden.description: A hunter's last page, wrapped in sticky silk.

Drowned Sailor.name: Water-Stained Log Page
Drowned Sailor.description: A page from a ship's log, hard to read.

Highland Ram.name: Highland Ram Horn
Highland Ram.description: Heavy, ridged, and still warm at the base. Southpoint renders these for lamp-oil, glue and buttons.

Highland Ram.name: Highland Ram Haunch
Highland Ram.description: Hill-fed mutton, dark and close-grained. The Tarren Mill common room can tell this from sheep at forty paces.

Hillsbrad Farmhand.name: Jar of Hillsbrad Loam
Hillsbrad Farmhand.description: A handful of field soil out of a seed bag, roots and mites and all. In Tirisfal this would be a miracle in a jar.

Worg Prowler.name: Ditchwater Sample
Worg Prowler.description: Scraped from the coat and gut of something that has been drinking the eastern ditches for a month. Cloudy, and it should not be.

Mudsnout Gnoll.name: Stolen Snare
Mudsnout Gnoll.description: Hand-twisted wire on a cut stake. Eleven winters of a trapper's work, hung up in a den as a trophy.

Mudsnout Gnoll.name: River Yew Stave
Mudsnout Gnoll.description: Cut from the river stand for den stakes. Heartwood and sapwood both - whoever felled it did not know what they had.

Mudsnout Gnoll.name: Hollow Bloodcap
Mudsnout Gnoll.description: A deep red fungus from the wet ground of the hollow. The value is all in the stem, so it has to be cut rather than pulled.

Mudsnout Shaman.name: Fouling from the Grating
Mudsnout Shaman.description: Pulled off the millrace intake above the weir. It is not weed, and it did not grow anywhere in this valley.

Syndicate Bandit.name: Unmarked Society Jar
Syndicate Bandit.description: A sealed apothecary's jar with the label soaked clean off. Nobody in Tarren Mill is willing to open it to find out.

Syndicate Bandit.name: Chapel Grave Marker
Syndicate Bandit.description: Cut stone with a name on it, taken out of the west bank chapel yard. Cut stone sells; names do not.

Syndicate Bandit.name: Oiled Route Card
Syndicate Bandit.description: Sewn inside a cuff: the fissure marked, and four months of arrivals kept nightly.

Syndicate Bandit.name: Syndicate Tally
Syndicate Bandit.description: A night's count of who went into the hole and who came back out.

Drowned Castaway.name: Swollen Signet Ring
Drowned Castaway.description: Silver, crested with a ship under three stars, and cut from a finger that had swollen around it.

Shadowfang Moonwalker.name: Annotated Keep Page
Shadowfang Moonwalker.description: A survey of a keep in a neat court hand, with the inner ward measured and the garrison strength noted in the margin. The keep is not this one.

Hoarfrost Yeti.name: Rimed Marrow
Hoarfrost Yeti.description: Still warm, which after forty years in that ice it has no business being.

Alterac Expeditionary.name: Frozen Survey Page
Alterac Expeditionary.description: An Alteraci hand, forty-one years old: THE READINGS ARE WRONG AND I AM GOING ON.

Alterac Expeditionary.name: Expedition Fitting
Alterac Expeditionary.description: A buckle, a strap-end, a lamp-bracket. Alterac make, and still done up.

Sporeback Grazer.name: Sporeback Cap
Sporeback Grazer.description: Broad, pale and faintly lit. The ones that look like faces are fine.

Lattice Sentry.name: Lattice Core
Lattice Sentry.description: The figure closes perfectly. It closes in the same place on every one of them.

Shard Diviner.name: Lattice Core
Shard Diviner.description: The figure closes perfectly. It closes in the same place on every one of them.

Lumen Leech.name: Lumen Sac
Lumen Leech.description: It holds the light at the phase you cut it, and the phase is never its own.

Archive Revenant.name: Worked Dalaran Fragment
Archive Revenant.description: Kirin Tor jointing. Cut, not broken, and never once weathered.

Archive Revenant.name: Unissued Catalogue Slip
Archive Revenant.description: Codex paper, Codex ink, and a number four hundred ahead of anything they have issued.

Archive Revenant.name: Catalogue Slip
Archive Revenant.description: Filed in the Codex's own sequence, for an object the Codex has not found.

Mycelial Husk.name: Live Bloom Thread
Mycelial Husk.description: Cut it and bag it before it dries. It does not like being cut.

Codex Dissident.name: Live Bloom Thread
Codex Dissident.description: Cut it and bag it before it dries. It does not like being cut.

Dim-Walker.name: Dim Residue
Dim-Walker.description: Cold in a jar, in a warm room, three days later.

The Unfinished.name: Riftward Residue
The Unfinished.description: Specified in one direction and simply not there in the other.

Riftward Aberration.name: Riftward Residue
Riftward Aberration.description: Specified in one direction and simply not there in the other.

Druse Crawler.name: Druse With an Inclusion
Druse Crawler.description: The crystal grew around something that was made. It is still in there.

Shelf-Grown.name: A Page, Grown
Shelf-Grown.description: The fibres run through the letters. The marks are part of the sheet. It is warm.

Shelf-Grown.name: Grown Leaf
Shelf-Grown.description: Ranked lines, close-written, in a hand that was never held.

Redscrub Scavenger.name: Seam Red Earth
Redscrub Scavenger.description: Barrens dust off the dry side of the line. It does not mix with what is beside it.

Redscrub Scavenger.name: Lift Ledger
Redscrub Scavenger.description: Damp, swollen, and still legible where it matters.

Seam-Struck Kodo.name: Undelivered Mail
Seam-Struck Kodo.description: A season of letters that were waiting to go down.

Rimcliff Harpy.name: Severed Cable End
Rimcliff Harpy.description: Lift wire, cut short for a nest.

Rimcliff Harpy.name: Harpy Sinew Coil
Rimcliff Harpy.description: Stronger than rope and considerably less pleasant.

Rimcliff Harpy.name: Wound Cable End
Rimcliff Harpy.description: Lift cable, wound into a nest base. The end is stretched, not cut.

Goldwood Lynx.name: Sound Aspen Bolt
Goldwood Lynx.description: Standing dead, cut to length, dry all the way through.

Aspen Elk.name: Thick Elk Haunch
Aspen Elk.description: Heavier than anything that came off the plain.

Quilboar Dencarver.name: Stolen Dam Timber
Quilboar Dencarver.description: Chewed at one end, cut square at the other.

Quilboar Dencarver.name: Brass Survey Pin
Quilboar Dencarver.description: Numbered, stamped with a mark you do not recognise, and kept wrapped in hide by something that could not read it.

Winterhide Bear.name: Meltwater Find
Winterhide Bear.description: Something the ice picked up a long time ago and has just put down.

Glacier Bear.name: Meltwater Find
Glacier Bear.description: Something the ice picked up a long time ago and has just put down.

Rimehowl.name: Glacier Hide and Hair
Rimehowl.description: Proof, for somebody across an ocean who asked a careful question.

Rimcliff Harpy Windcaller.name: Harpy Sinew Coil
Rimcliff Harpy Windcaller.description: Stronger than rope and considerably less pleasant.

Galak Outrider.name: Galak Toll Tally
Galak Outrider.description: A slip of hide, itemised, dated and carried forward. That is the part nobody in Freewind can get past.

Galak Wrangler.name: Galak Toll Tally
Galak Wrangler.description: A slip of hide, itemised, dated and carried forward.

Galak Khan's Chosen.name: Toll Ledger Leaf
Galak Khan's Chosen.description: A page out of the book the slips are torn from. Four columns, and the fourth one is not a charge.

Sheerwing Harpy.name: Sheerwing Course-Weave
Sheerwing Harpy.description: Laid in courses like thatch, with a turn at the end of each one.

Sheerwing Rooktender.name: Sheerwing Course-Weave
Sheerwing Rooktender.description: Nest-work, and better nest-work than the city will admit.

Sunstruck Elk.name: Sunstruck Marrow
Sunstruck Elk.description: An animal that starves and an animal that cooks do not leave the same marrow.

Sunstruck Elk.name: Wash-Bed Fodder
Sunstruck Elk.description: The only green on the whole floor, and it is green because that is where the year's water went.

Rimstalker Scorpid.name: Wash-Bed Fodder
Rimstalker Scorpid.description: Cut from the shade of a cut bank, where it is cool and things do not move for you.

Rimstalker Scorpid.name: Seam Ground Sample
Rimstalker Scorpid.description: Red hardpan off the line where the timber quits.

Downslope Lynx.name: Seam Ground Sample
Downslope Lynx.description: Scraped off the ground they are dying on.

Saltspite Elemental.name: Saltwatch Pan Clay
Saltspite Elemental.description: Grey, from under the crust. Everyone said it would not fire.

Saltspite Elemental.name: Fused Pan Shard
Saltspite Elemental.description: Off the rim of a sheet you can see the sky in.

Dryhollow Basilisk.name: Fused Pan Shard
Dryhollow Basilisk.description: Fused all the way through, not glazed.

Saltbound Shambler.name: Salt-Set Tally Stick
Saltbound Shambler.description: Notched, and the notches are a salt crew's count. Somebody kept this.

Sightless Kodo.name: Sound Aspen Bolt
Sightless Kodo.description: Standing dead, cut to length, dry all the way through. The flood brought it down and the cave kept it.

Galak Windcatcher.name: Galak Road-Tally
Galak Windcatcher.description: A running balance, kept against something, in a hand better than the city clerk's. The fourth column is not a charge and you cannot read what it is.

Washline Scuttler.name: Drowned Crew Token
Washline Scuttler.description: Bone, drilled once, worn smooth on one face by a thumb. It was carried by somebody for a long time before the water got it.

Vinecrest Raptor.name: Grom'gol Crate Stave
Vinecrest Raptor.description: A board off a camp crate. The end of it is flat, which is not what a raptor leaves you.

Zul'Marosh Stonehand.name: Grom'gol Crate Stave
Zul'Marosh Stonehand.description: Camp lumber, carried off the road and not yet dressed.

Zul'Marosh Stonehand.name: Dressed Stair Batten
Zul'Marosh Stonehand.description: Thin, cut to one length, with a lashing notch at the end. Somebody is standing on these to reach something.

Zul'Marosh Stonehand.name: Loose Course Stone
Zul'Marosh Stonehand.description: Old grey stair stone, dressed on five faces.

Zul'Marosh Stonehand.name: Four-Faced Relief Chip
Zul'Marosh Stonehand.description: Carried down off the scaffold and dropped on the cutline.

Thornback Ape.name: Dressed Stair Batten
Thornback Ape.description: Taken off the cutline, where the apes come down for anything that smells of the camp.

Thornback Ape.name: Buttress Resin
Thornback Ape.description: Prised out of the bark of a buttress tree. It burns wet, which is the whole miracle of it.

Thornback Ape.name: Pressed Feed Block
Thornback Ape.description: Taken back off an ape that took it off the feed store first.

Mangrove Stiltstalker.name: Mangrove Bark Strip
Mangrove Stiltstalker.description: Off the water-side root. Dead'wa, if you are going to say it properly.

Bloatspawn Toad.name: Mangrove Bark Strip
Bloatspawn Toad.description: Trodden into the root mud and still good for a wash.

Bloatspawn Toad.name: Rotgas Bladder
Bloatspawn Toad.description: It comes up out of the rot full and goes back down empty, and in between the fen smokes.

Mistvale Crocolisk.name: Berth Manifest Bundle
Mistvale Crocolisk.description: Oilcloth, lashed, with a requisition number on the outside and a name in the cargo column.

Zul'Marosh Stairwarden.name: Loose Course Stone
Zul'Marosh Stairwarden.description: Fallen rather than laid. The fifth face is still rough.

Zul'Marosh Stairwarden.name: Four-Faced Relief Chip
Zul'Marosh Stairwarden.description: Off the NEW work, which is dressed on four faces by somebody who has never seen the stair finished.

Zul'Marosh Vinespeaker.name: Vinespeaker's Knot-Cord
Zul'Marosh Vinespeaker.description: A record, in knots, and not one knot in it is three years old.

Sourwater Ooze.name: Rotgas Bladder
Sourwater Ooze.description: They go through these like a boot through ice, and the camp calls the result a fire.

Sourwater Ooze.name: Sourwater Tuber
Sourwater Ooze.description: Come up out of the rot with the ooze on it. It still works.

Rootgrubber Boar.name: Buttress Resin
Rootgrubber Boar.description: Rooted out of the bark and trodden into the mulch, which is where you will be getting it from.

Rootgrubber Boar.name: Pressed Feed Block
Rootgrubber Boar.description: Boar fat and jungle grain beaten together until it goes hard. A wyvern eats before a long crossing, not during one.

Rootgrubber Boar.name: Rootgrubber Haunch
Rootgrubber Boar.description: Off the leg, not the gut. A raptor that gets slop remembers it.

Bloodvine Raptor.name: Kerb-Line Bloodvine
Bloodvine Raptor.description: Cut out of the kerb stone the camber depends on. Nine days and it is back.

Greenwater Adder.name: Kerb-Line Bloodvine
Greenwater Adder.description: Pulled out of a drain the adders had no business nesting in.

Gurbashi Beast-Drover.name: Drover's Stock Tally
Gurbashi Beast-Drover.description: Signed in at weight. The weight is not the weight.

Snapjaw Leechswarm.name: Spray-Band Moss
Snapjaw Leechswarm.description: It only grows where the fall reaches, which is a smaller fact than it sounds and a more expensive one.

Snapjaw Leechswarm.name: Net Line Catch
Snapjaw Leechswarm.description: Pulled in off a line and reset the way it was found.

Nightpelt Panther.name: Spray-Band Moss
Nightpelt Panther.description: Taken off the lip at dusk, which is when the lip belongs to something else.

Zul'Rath Mistcaller.name: Terrace Name Stone
Zul'Rath Mistcaller.description: Set into the lip of a terrace. One of the four names, and not the one you were given.

Zul'Rath Mistcaller.name: Veilfall Tally Cord
Zul'Rath Mistcaller.description: Knotted once a morning and read against yesterday's.

Zul'Rath Shrinekeeper.name: Terrace Name Stone
Zul'Rath Shrinekeeper.description: Carried by whoever is senior on a terrace, because the name is the post.

Spraywater Elemental.name: Veilfall Tally Cord
Spraywater Elemental.description: Wet through, and the knots have not slipped in three years of it.

Mosh'Ogg Rockthrower.name: Midden Find
Mosh'Ogg Rockthrower.description: A made thing, off a pile of mostly unmade ones.

Mosh'Ogg Rockthrower.name: Stamped Crate Nail
Mosh'Ogg Rockthrower.description: Square cut, flat headed, shipping timber only - and a run number struck into the head clean enough to read in bad light.

Mosh'Ogg Brute.name: Midden Find
Mosh'Ogg Brute.description: They pick up whatever catches the light and they do not look at it twice.

Snapjaw Crocolisk.name: Net Line Catch
Snapjaw Crocolisk.description: Taken back off the one that took it.

Snapjaw Crocolisk.name: Silt-Set Wager Slip
Snapjaw Crocolisk.description: Salt-stiff and brown at the folds. A name, a round and a price, and the price is far too good.

Drumhide Gorilla.name: Drumhide Scrap
Drumhide Gorilla.description: Thick, grey and faintly dusty. It is not what the big drums are made of.

Gurbashi Drum-Caller.name: Drover's Stock Tally
Gurbashi Drum-Caller.description: Taken off a drummer, which is the part that should worry somebody.

Limewing Bat.name: Veilfall Tally Cord
Limewing Bat.description: Chewed at one end. The knots are intact, which is the only part that matters.

Coilvine Python.name: Coil of Strangler Vine
Coilvine Python.description: Cut long and cut fresh, before it goes woody. Exactly the colour of the thing that was lying along it.

Rotvine Strangler.name: Coil of Strangler Vine
Rotvine Strangler.description: Green and wet and still trying. The cave grows it faster than the road does.

Fenrot Creeper.name: Sourwater Tuber
Fenrot Creeper.description: Pale, about a thumb long, and it pulls the water out of whatever you pack it against.

Saltscale Salvager.name: Saltscale Fitting-Line
Saltscale Salvager.description: Forged rings and pins strung on a line, the way you would carry keys, and in gauge order from one end to the other.

Kundaraz Stoneshaper.name: Stoneshaper's Rule
Kundaraz Stoneshaper.description: A notched rod. The notches are a measure, and the measure is the one the arena floor is laid to.

Bloodsail Bosun.name: Bosun's Landing Tally
Bloodsail Bosun.description: What each beached keel paid to come ashore, in a worse hand than Nizzik's and for a considerably worse toll.

Kundaraz Tidecaller.name: Weir Pin
Kundaraz Tidecaller.description: Cut stone, tapered, meant to sit in a wall junction and let a hall fill at a chosen rate rather than at the sea's.

Pit-Stock Raptor.name: Brass Consignment Tag
Pit-Stock Raptor.description: Punched through the hide at the shoulder and numbered, because a goblin paid by the head counts the heads.

Bloodsail Cannoneer.name: Builder's Plate
Bloodsail Cannoneer.description: Riveted to a frame inboard, where the barnacle never got: a yard, a year and a hull number, all three still legible.

Dustwheel Scrapper.name: Dustwheel Pry Bar
Dustwheel Scrapper.description: Flattened at one end from being used as something else.

Dustwheel Scrapper.name: Salvage Tag
Dustwheel Scrapper.description: A numbered tin tag. The rule it refers to is real.

Dustwheel Boilerman.name: Scorched Boiler Plate
Dustwheel Boilerman.description: Blued through in a ring where it ran too hot.

Dustwheel Wheelman.name: Course-Worn Wheel
Dustwheel Wheelman.description: Flat-spotted on one side. It was driven, not parked.

Dustwheel Wheelman.name: Water-Stained Entry Slip
Dustwheel Wheelman.description: An entry slip for the Saltwheel Open. The season on it is three years old and the name has been scratched out and rewritten twice.

Saltcrust Skitterer.name: Crusted Mandible
Saltcrust Skitterer.description: Salt has grown over the edge and not blunted it.

Pan-Crawler Drone.name: Wet Resin
Pan-Crawler Drone.description: Sets hard in an hour and never fully sets.

Hive Spitter.name: Spitter's Sac
Hive Spitter.description: Still under pressure. Doc Pellik would like it on a table.

Flats Tunneler.name: Tunnel Spoil
Flats Tunneler.description: Pan dug out from underneath and brought up dry.

Flats Tunneler.name: Salt-Sealed Tin
Flats Tunneler.description: A tin sealed with lead against the salt, dug up out of the pan. Something is still dry inside it.

Crustback Scorpid.name: Crustback Barb
Crustback Scorpid.description: The salt keeps the venom from drying out. Nobody knows why.

Salt Vulture.name: Salt-Stiff Quill
Salt Vulture.description: It does not bend any more. It never will.

Mirage Basilisk.name: Clouded Basilisk Eye
Mirage Basilisk.description: Looking into it is like looking down the pan at noon.

Sandfury Scavenger.name: Pried Fitting
Sandfury Scavenger.description: Goblin brass, levered off something that was not theirs.

Sandfury Scavenger.name: Sandfury Charm
Sandfury Scavenger.description: Bone and wire. It means something to somebody.

Sandfury Axethrower.name: Notched Throwing Axe
Sandfury Axethrower.description: Thrown a great many times and sharpened fewer.

Sandfury Hexxer.name: Hex Fetish
Sandfury Hexxer.description: Still warm, which it should not be.

Gadgetzan Scrapjaw.name: Chewed Ledger
Gadgetzan Scrapjaw.description: A page and a half legible. Both of them are figures.

Gadgetzan Scrapjaw.name: Well-Token
Gadgetzan Scrapjaw.description: A stamped brass token from Gadgetzan's public well. The date on the back is three years old and the number on the front is very high.

Dunecrest Raptor.name: Dunecrest Claw
Dunecrest Raptor.description: Sand-polished to a shine along one edge.

Thornback Scorpid.name: Thornback Barb
Thornback Scorpid.description: The venom stays wet out here and nobody knows why.

Bonefield Hyena.name: Hyena Jaw
Bonefield Hyena.description: Everything that stops on that road is theirs by morning.

Carrion Vulture of Tanaris.name: Sun-Stiff Quill
Carrion Vulture of Tanaris.description: It does not bend any more and it never will.

Sunbleached Basilisk.name: Bleached Basilisk Eye
Sunbleached Basilisk.description: Clouded right through, like the air at noon.

Sunstone Elemental.name: Sunstone Core
Sunstone Elemental.description: Too hot to hold and it has been out of the sun for a day.

Drownbell Deckhand.name: Cove Tally-Stick
Drownbell Deckhand.description: Notched, and the notches are not days.

Drownbell Bosun.name: Bosun's Whistle
Drownbell Bosun.description: Brass, green with salt, and still loud.

Cove Tidecaller.name: Tidecaller's Focus
Cove Tidecaller.description: Cold in a cave that is not cold.

Bilge Crawler.name: Crawler Shell
Bilge Crawler.description: Thin, curved, and sharper than it has any right to be.

Drownbell Cutthroat.name: Water-Stained Salvage Claim
Drownbell Cutthroat.description: A salvage claim on something in the cove, filed by a company nobody in Steamwheedle has heard of, and countersigned twice.

Sunbleached Stalker.name: Scavenger's Scratch-Tally
Sunbleached Stalker.description: Notches for everything that came up the road and did not go back down.

Lattice-Grown.name: Lattice Core
Lattice-Grown.description: The piece in the middle that the rest of it grew out from.

Lattice-Grown.name: Rough Vein Glass
Lattice-Grown.description: Broken off the exposed face. Cold the moment anything is cast near it.

Vein-Lit Wisp.name: Settled Vein-Light
Vein-Lit Wisp.description: It keeps shining after the thing that was carrying it has stopped.

Pool Horror.name: Sealed Deepwater Flask
Pool Horror.description: Water from the bottom of the only pool in Tanaris, in Nix's leaded glass.

Sodden Digger.name: Shift Token
Sodden Digger.description: Brass, stamped with a number, and the number is still on the board.

Glass Weaver.name: Spun Vein-Glass
Glass Weaver.description: Drawn out into a thread by something that had a reason to.

Seam Singer.name: Struck Shard
Seam Singer.description: It is still ringing. It has been out of the Choir for a day.

Terrace Basilisk.name: Survey Marker, Bent
Terrace Basilisk.description: Driven into the second terrace by somebody methodical, and chewed.

Cistern Lurker.name: Waterlogged Ledger
Cistern Lurker.description: Company accounts, four hundred feet down, and the last entry is a date.

Shardback Crawler.name: Salvaged Housing Iron
Shardback Crawler.description: Chewed off a pump casing on the spoil heap and not improved by it.

Shardback Crawler.name: Rough Vein Glass
Shardback Crawler.description: Broken off the exposed face. Cold the moment anything is cast near it.

Shelf Prowler.name: Blindweed Cutting
Shelf Prowler.description: Pulled out of the bed the prowler had flattened to sleep in.

Waterline Serpent.name: Tideglass Core
Waterline Serpent.description: Grown in moving water, and it has a grain that says which way.

Cartfall Scavenger.name: Lifted Brass
Cartfall Scavenger.description: Brass cart fittings, pried off the survey camp's spares.

Cartfall Scavenger.name: Sealed Waybill
Cartfall Scavenger.description: A cargo manifest with the seal unbroken, for a cart that went into a pit.

Sunken Drover.name: Drover's Tag
Sunken Drover.description: Stamped with a house mark and a number. The house is in Steamwheedle.

Pitfall Kodo.name: Fouled Harness Strap
Pitfall Kodo.description: The strap's been cut. Somebody tried to get the animal out.

Limestone Crawler.name: Crawler Shell-Plate
Limestone Crawler.description: Thin and curved, and stronger than it looks.

Limestone Crawler.name: Peg Head, Snapped
Limestone Crawler.description: The top few inches of a survey stake. You can still read the number.

Hollowing Ooze.name: Settled Residue
Hollowing Ooze.description: What a Hollowing Ooze leaves behind after eating limestone.

Glasswall Elemental.name: Fused Wall-Shard
Glasswall Elemental.description: Sand that's melted into glass. It's warm to hold.

Deepwater Horror.name: Still-Wet Scale
Deepwater Horror.description: It's been in a bag in the desert for a day and it's still damp.

Saltbone Revenant.name: Salted Knucklebone
Saltbone Revenant.description: Cured in brine, four days' walk from the nearest salt.

Sinkhole Lurker.name: Lurker's Spur
Sinkhole Lurker.description: A hooked spur for gripping a pit wall in the dark.

Pit Shrike.name: Shrike's Crop
Pit Shrike.description: Whatever the bird ate last is still in it.

Southsea Netcaster.name: Cut Boarding Net
Southsea Netcaster.description: Weighted at the hem. It is for people, not fish.

Southsea Powdermonkey.name: Short-Weight Powder Keg
Southsea Powdermonkey.description: Steamwheedle cooperage, and the mark has been scraped at.

Southsea Rigger.name: Prize Tag
Southsea Rigger.description: A cargo tag, re-inked. The first hand under it is Hesper Dunn's.

Southsea Swabbie.name: Pulled Ship's Nail
Southsea Swabbie.description: Drawn out of a hull that somebody was taking apart for the iron.

Hulk Rat.name: Chewed Ship's Articles
Hulk Rat.description: The crew agreement of a vessel that is no longer a vessel, half eaten.

Highland Fleshripper.name: Fleshripper Dewclaw
Highland Fleshripper.description: Four punctures in an arc, and the arc is wider than a wolf's.

Moor Adder.name: Moor Adder Gland
Moor Adder.description: They come up onto warm road stone at dusk. That is when the camp gets bitten.

Syndicate Footpad.name: Syndicate Wall Tally
Syndicate Footpad.description: A slip with a number on it. Everyone crossing that gap is carrying one.

Syndicate Watchman.name: Go'Shek Field Tally
Syndicate Watchman.description: A man guarding a harvest has to know how much harvest there is.

Syndicate Shadowmage.name: Go'Shek Grain Contract
Syndicate Shadowmage.description: Signed, countersigned, and the buyer's mark is older than the Syndicate.

Syndicate Shadowmage.name: Overseer's Ledger Leaf
Syndicate Shadowmage.description: Off the desk in the main house. Any three will do the damage.

Syndicate Prowler.name: Forged Stromgarde Writ
Syndicate Prowler.description: The seal work is immaculate. Whoever does these trained in a chancery that no longer exists.

Syndicate Prowler.name: Sealed Consignment
Syndicate Prowler.description: Wax, intact, and the mark on it is a Hillsbrad merchant house. A road bandit should not be carrying a sealed anything.

Witherbark Shadowcaster.name: Turned Listening Charm
Witherbark Shadowcaster.description: Trolls bury these facing out. This one faced in.

Bound Sentinel.name: Sentinel Core Fragment
Bound Sentinel.description: Ring stone. They are made of the circles they stand around.

Mere Crawler.name: Mere Crawler Bladder
Mere Crawler.description: Freshwater organism with a salt-gland, eighty miles from the sea.

Mere Crawler.name: Freshwater Mere Pearl
Mere Crawler.description: Something down there is making them. In rows, four to a row.

Brine-Choked Digger.name: Sump-Floor Offering
Brine-Choked Digger.description: Left on the floor, arranged. A creature that arranges things is not mining any more.

The Pick-Mother.name: Brood Shell
The Pick-Mother.description: Laid at blood heat, eleven degrees above the rock around it.

Wrackline Cutter.name: Wreck Manifest Tin
Wrackline Cutter.description: Bolted inside the stern post. Three of the four name the same buyer.

Wrackline Cutter.name: Bronze Wreck Fitting
Wrackline Cutter.description: Three years of salt has not touched it. The iron beside it is a brown stain.

Wrackline Bosun.name: Wrackline Watch Order
Wrackline Bosun.description: Three islands, three orders, one hand.

Storm Petrel Swarm.name: Petrel Down Bundle
Storm Petrel Swarm.description: They took the lee side of Bothy Rock by weight of numbers.

Reefmaw.name: Barbed Tooth
Reefmaw.description: No animal grows a barbed tooth to eat with.

Barrow Shade.name: Drowned Keepsake
Barrow Shade.description: A ring, a coin, a lock of hair. People carry one when they go out on water they are not sure of.

Arathor Revenant.name: Arathor Watch-Token
Arathor Revenant.description: Bronze, worn smooth, stamped with a march that has been under water for three thousand years. It was being carried, not worn.

Overseer Ratch.name: Ratch's Shift Whistle
Overseer Ratch.description: Bone, drilled, and the mouthpiece worn through to a different colour. They still came when it blew.

Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.name: Ashkin's Consignment Book
Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.description: Three years of consignments and every one of them goes to the same mark. He kept it high up and dry, which is the only sense in that cave.

Sister Mollis.name: The Evening Office
Sister Mollis.description: Every evening for three years, in a roofless chapel, to nobody. The last entry is this week.

The Vault-Thing.name: Arathor Coffer-Seal
The Vault-Thing.description: The empire that sealed this did not write down what it was sealing. That is a decision, not carelessness.

Thane Aldric's Shade.name: March-Lord's Signet
Thane Aldric's Shade.description: The name, the office, and the march it was an office of. Nobody has read it in three thousand years.

Greater Plainstrider.name: Unbroken Plainstrider Feather
Greater Plainstrider.description: Long, grey, and every barb still zipped. Snix will know.

Ashdune Basilisk.name: Basilisk Fat
Ashdune Basilisk.description: Burns slow and hot. The gate braziers run on it.

Ashdune Basilisk.name: Petrified Pick
Ashdune Basilisk.description: A miner's pick turned to grey stone, haft and all. There's a name cut in the haft.

Lantern Sporeling.name: Unopened Lantern Cap
Lantern Sporeling.description: Picked before it opened. Still faintly blue.

Gloomcap Trampler.name: Trampler Gill
Gloomcap Trampler.description: Thick as a hand and damp. It smells of cellar.

Blindwater Lurker.name: Worked Shell
Blindwater Lurker.description: A shell with a hole drilled through it and a pattern scratched round the hole.

Blindwater Lurker.name: Lurker's Water Bladder
Blindwater Lurker.description: Full of water from the Last Water. Very cold and slightly bitter.

Castout Digger.name: Shift Tally Stick
Castout Digger.description: Notched for every cart a miner filled, with the gallery's mark burned in the end.

Castout Slagcaller.name: Shrine Ember
Castout Slagcaller.description: Still burning in its clay pot. It doesn't go out.

Hive Resinspitter.name: Clear Amber Resin
Hive Resinspitter.description: Soft while it's warm. Sets harder than glass.

Hive Reaver.name: Reaver Carapace
Hive Reaver.description: A back-plate the size of a shield, and lighter.

Hive Swarmer.name: Half-Eaten Lantern Cap
Hive Swarmer.description: A mushroom cap with neat scythe-cuts through it. Something was carrying it, not eating it.

Castout Cutthroat.name: Unsent Letter
Castout Cutthroat.description: Folded small and worn at the creases. It's addressed to Brenna Coalcask at the Banked Fire.

Bargebreaker Crab.name: Bargebreaker Claw
Bargebreaker Crab.description: As long as a forearm and full of sweet meat.

Bargebreaker Crab.name: Goblin Sea Boot
Bargebreaker Crab.description: A small tarred boot with a brass toe. It's been chewed.

Ashfur Gorilla.name: Chewed Bitterbark
Ashfur Gorilla.description: A wad of grey bark, chewed soft. The gorillas pack it on their burns.

Shallows Snapper.name: Snapper Fat
Shallows Snapper.description: Clean white fat from under the shell. It doesn't go rancid in the heat.

Wreckpicker Murloc.name: Seasoned Wreck Timber
Wreckpicker Murloc.description: Oak that's been under salt water for years. It's harder than the day it was cut.

Wreckpicker Murloc.name: Sealed Cargo Cask
Wreckpicker Murloc.description: Small, heavy and still sealed with pitch. Something inside it shifts.

Wreckpicker Murloc.name: Seaman's Discharge Book
Wreckpicker Murloc.description: A small stiff booklet with a photograph inside the cover and stamps from ports that aren't on any map here.

Wreckpicker Murloc.name: Waterlogged Ship's Log
Wreckpicker Murloc.description: A hardbound book swollen with sea water. The writing is in ink, in a language the dwarves and goblins don't read.

Gate-Squatter Brawler.name: Ashclaim Supply Crate
Gate-Squatter Brawler.description: Stencilled with the Ashclaim's mark and a jetty tally number.

Gate-Squatter Brawler.name: Ashclaim Pay Chit
Gate-Squatter Brawler.description: A brass tag from the landing stores, stamped with a porter's number. A squatter was wearing it on a string.

Gate-Squatter Ashpreacher.name: Ash-Prayer Tablet
Gate-Squatter Ashpreacher.description: A slate rubbed grey with ash. The same line is scratched into it over and over.

Rubble Basilisk.name: Basilisk Gizzard Stone
Rubble Basilisk.description: A pebble polished in a basilisk's gut. This one has a silver streak.

Crazed Miner.name: Pouch of Black Dust
Crazed Miner.description: Fine as flour and black as a chimney. It clings to the cloth.

Ash-Wretch.name: Ashhold Name-Tablet
Ash-Wretch.description: A thumb of iron with a name punched into it. Every Dark Iron of Khaz Varun carried one.

Masked Zealot.name: Zealot's Iron Mask
Masked Zealot.description: Riveted shut at the back, all the way round.

The Crusher.name: Stonecast Breastplate
The Crusher.description: Dented, black with soot and unmistakably fine work. There's a maker's mark under the left arm.

Overseer Grall.name: Roll of Oaths
Overseer Grall.description: A scroll of thin iron leaves on a ring. Every leaf is a name and a promise.

Stormscale Naga Raider.name: Barge Nameboard
Stormscale Naga Raider.description: A plank with a barge's name burned into it and a Cinderwharf berth number underneath.

Stormscale Naga Raider.name: Naga Boarding Hook
Stormscale Naga Raider.description: A barbed iron hook on a length of kelp rope. The barbs are full of pine splinters.

Stormscale Naga Raider.name: Naga Tide-Chart
Stormscale Naga Raider.description: A sheet of sharkskin pricked with holes. Held to the light it shows a coastline and a line running through the reefs.

Scourcoast Crab.name: Scourcoast Crab Meat
Scourcoast Crab.description: Dark, firm and faintly smoky, as if it had been cooked already.

Scourcoast Crab.name: Barnacled Brass Fitting
Scourcoast Crab.description: A ship's fitting gone green under its barnacles. The casting's too fine for goblin work.

Steamvent Ooze.name: Ooze Membrane
Steamvent Ooze.description: A sheet of clear rubbery skin. Acid beads on it and runs off.

Ashplain Basilisk.name: Ashplain Basilisk Hide
Ashplain Basilisk.description: Thick, pebbled and almost impossible to tear.

Ventborn Flame Spirit.name: Yellow Fissure Crust
Ventborn Flame Spirit.description: A brittle yellow crust that stinks of eggs. It leaves gold dust on your fingers.

Tarfoot Gorilla.name: Ball of Vent Tar
Tarfoot Gorilla.description: Black, soft and warm. It came off a gorilla's foot and it'll stick to anything.

Calderaborn Drake.name: Fresh Caldera Glass
Calderaborn Drake.description: Black glass with a skin of bubbles. It's still warm in the middle.

Sulphur Crawler.name: Sulphur Crawler Gland
Sulphur Crawler.description: A fat yellow sac that hisses when you squeeze it.

The Molten Serpent.name: Molten Serpent Scale
The Molten Serpent.description: A scale the size of a shield. It glows dull red and it hasn't cooled at all.

Scoria Fire Elemental.name: Half-Melted Works Lantern
Scoria Fire Elemental.description: An Ashclaim carter's lantern, slumped down one side. The brass number plate has survived.

Resin Weaver.name: Royal Resin
Resin Weaver.description: Clear amber resin, still soft. It hardens in a few hours.

Brine-Wight.name: Barrow Coin
Brine-Wight.description: Old gold, green with salt, stamped with a king nobody remembers.

Drowned Barrow-Thane.name: Barrow Coin
Drowned Barrow-Thane.description: Old gold, green with salt, stamped with a king nobody remembers.

Glassback Basilisk.name: Fused Glass Shard
Glassback Basilisk.description: A splinter of the canyon's glass, pulled from a basilisk's back. Still warm.

Mere Wraith.name: Vial of Mere-Water
Mere Wraith.description: Black water that doesn't settle. It moves a little when you aren't holding it still.

Rootbound Guardian.name: Glowing Sap
Rootbound Guardian.description: Amber sap that gives off its own light. It's warm, like something's alive in it.

Idol-Drowned Troll.name: Jade Idol Shard
Idol-Drowned Troll.description: A chip of green stone off a drowned god. It's cold, and it hums.

Drowned Hexer.name: Jade Idol Shard
Drowned Hexer.description: A chip of green stone off a drowned god. It's cold, and it hums.

Dune Revenant.name: Caravan Manifest Page
Dune Revenant.description: A page from a ledger, sand-scoured, every line a debt.
